description: Main source file for a Flutter application that loads and displays local HTML assets via webview_flutter, manages routing and asset loading, and provides fallback error handling.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application managing routes and navigation.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: Index page listing all generated route screens with navigation.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Screen widget that displays a local HTML asset inside a scaffold with an app bar.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: Stateful widget that loads and displays HTML content from assets and handles errors.

classes.name: UnknownRouteScreen
classes.description: Simple widget shown for unknown routes (404).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget, responsible for rendering UI components.

methods.name: _loadHtml
methods.description: Loads HTML asset, injects base href, and sets up WebView content or fallback on error.

methods.name: _injectBaseHref
methods.description: Injects a base href=/assets/ into HTML to resolve relative URLs.

methods.name: _fallbackErrorHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML page displayed when asset loading fails, showing error details.

methods.name: _escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in strings.
